itinerary: Day 0: Departure from Lahore 09:30 PM (food not included)
Day 1: Pick Islamabad participants, breakfast at Besham, overnight Chilas, dinner 8 PM
Day 2: Drive to Hunza via KKH, Nanga Parbat & Rakaposhi viewpoints, Altit Fort
Day 3: Attabad Lake boating, Passu Cones, Husaini Bridge, Khunjerab Pass, BBQ bonfire
Day 4: Baltit Fort & shopping, jeep to Naltar Valley, depart Chillas 5 PM
Day 5: Breakfast 6 AM, depart Chillas 6:30 AM, return to Lahore/Islamabad
pros: Attabad Lake boat tickets included in package price
BBQ dinner and bonfire night included
All tolls and taxes covered, first-aid kit provided
Cheapest of the four at Rs 14,500/head from Lahore & Islamabad
cons: Fort entry tickets (Altit, Baltit) not included
Basic 3-4 person sharing rooms; couples pay Rs 2,500 extra for separate room
verdict: Budget-priced group trip with Attabad boating and BBQ bundled in, but several add-on charges and shared rooms make the headline price misleading. Best for cost-driven travellers who don't mind extras.
excludes: Naltar jeep, Khunjerab jeep if needed, fort tickets, drinks/laundry/calls, insurance/medical.

itinerary: Day 0: Departure from Lahore 9-10 PM with short en-route stays
Day 1: Pickup Islamabad members en route, dinner and overnight Chilas
Day 2: Depart for Hunza ~8-9 AM, viewpoint stops, arrive Hunza 3-4 PM
Day 3: Khunjerab Pass Pak-China border, Passu Cones, Hussaini Bridge, Attabad Lake
Day 4: Baltit/Altit Fort, jeep transfer to Naltar Valley, return to Chillas/Naran
Day 5: Breakfast at hotel, arrive Lahore ~12:00 PM
pros: Professional guide plus BBQ and bonfire night included
Generous meal plan of 5 breakfasts and 4 dinners
Clear quad and couple pricing published
cons: Naltar Valley jeep charges explicitly excluded
All entry tickets of any kind excluded
Water sports and lunch not included
Couple price (PKR 70,000) is steep vs quad-sharing rate
verdict: A comfort-focused group tour with luxury coaches and a full meal plan, well-suited to travellers wanting reliability over budget. Naltar jeep and ticket extras still apply.
excludes: Naltar Valley jeep charges, entry tickets of any kind, water sports, lunch, and unlisted items.

itinerary: Day 1: Islamabad to Naran to Chilas, Kaghan, Lulusar Lake, Babusar Top, overnight Chilas
Day 2: Chilas, jeep at Nomal to Naltar lakes, Altit & Baltit Forts, overnight Hunza
Day 3: Attabad Lake, Passu Cones, Hussaini Bridge, Yak Grill, Khunjerab Pass, overnight Hunza
Day 4: Hunza to Naran/Burawai with sightseeing and Babusar Top, overnight
Day 5: Early breakfast, drive home via Balakot to Islamabad/Lahore
pros: Most detailed Naltar coverage: Satrangi, Blue Water and Pari lakes named
5 breakfasts & 4 dinners, bonfire and traditional musical night included
Four room tiers (Standard to Executive) with full per-person pricing
cons: Naltar jeep charge PKR 3,000/head is extra
Entry and activity tickets not included
Solo and higher-tier pricing escalates sharply (up to PKR 137,000)
verdict: The richest itinerary of the four, with named Naltar lakes and a wide tier ladder from PKR 28,000. Note dinners drop off on upper tiers, so compare the meal inclusions carefully.
excludes: Naltar Valley jeep charges (PKR 3,000/head), entry tickets, activity charges, dinner on higher tiers, personal expenses.

itinerary: Day 0: Receive participants at Thokar Niaz Baig, Lahore at 9 PM
Day 1: Pickup Rawalpindi 2 AM, breakfast Besham, Umbrella Waterfall & Daso, overnight Chilas
Day 2: Nanga Parbat viewpoint, Altit Fort, Baltit Fort, Karimabad Bazaar, overnight Hunza
Day 3: Attabad Tunnels & Lake, Hussaini Bridge, Passu Glacier & Cones, Khunjerab, BBQ musical night
Day 4: Jeep to Naltar Valley, ski slope & ice hockey ground, overnight Chilas (jeep ~Rs 2000 extra)
Day 5: Return via Daso Dam, lunch stop, drop Islamabad by 9 PM then Lahore
pros: BBQ, bonfire and musical night on Day 3
Adds unique stops (Umbrella Waterfall, Daso Dam, Naltar ski slope)
cons: Room cooling/heating, fort and boating tickets all excluded
Couple rate (PKR 72,000) is the highest of the four
verdict: A standard 5-day group tour at PKR 30,000/person with a few distinctive sightseeing stops and an honest Naltar jeep estimate, but tight 4-5 person rooms and many ticket exclusions.
excludes: Entry tickets, beverages, jeep charges (~Rs 2,000/head Naltar), fort/boating tickets, personal insurance, room cooling/heating.
